results.name: chaosTarget
results.reason: Learn version selector lists 2025-01-01 as latest stable GA. Exact PUT body Target requires properties, supplied as {}; the empty object is valid against the unconstrained additionalProperties schema. location is optional, and scope maps to the parent-resource route.
results.migration: Current 2025-01-01 is latest GA; no GA migration needed.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: body:8: Bicep source JSON Pointer /name (expression "name: 'microsoft-azurekubernetesservicechaosmesh'"); Bicep target name is the REST targetName path parameter, not a JSON body field; the mandated literal target name is a string.

usage.label: scope
usage.analysis: body:61: Bicep source JSON Pointer /scope (expression 'scope: aksCluster'); Bicep scope aksCluster selects the parent managed-cluster route segments; it is not a request-body property and is not the optional Target.location.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: body:86: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties (expression 'properties: {}'); Maps to Target.properties, the only required writable request member; the exact empty object is valid because the REST schema permits additionalProperties with no narrower constraint.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: header:line:0: Bicep source JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 (expression "resource chaosTarget 'Microsoft.Chaos/targets@2025-01-01' ="); Resource header identifies the current API version; it is not a request property.

current.analysis: Learn selector and pinned stable OpenAPI identify 2025-01-01. The Target PUT body expands through ProxyResource; properties is the sole required member, and its object schema has unconstrained additionalProperties. Bicep sends properties: {}. Target.location is optional; Bicep scope maps to the parent-resource route.

ga.analysis: Latest GA from the Learn version selector is 2025-01-01; later versions are preview. Current and candidate stable schema are the same pinned OpenAPI file.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log reports no properties added, updated, or removed in 2025-01-01. The required properties object remains present, and no changed fields are used.
